g.text: Peer-to-peer query resolution — GET /api/aircrafts/{registrationNumber} (US103, contract B1a)
Parallel calls with timeout + retry + circuit breaker.
The same flow serves contract B1a (Flight Routes, Maintenance) and B1b (GET /api/aircraft-models/{name}).
No replica has it → 404. A peer down/timing out is counted as unavailable
